hero.cathedral-town.amanda.biography: Similar as Gabrielle, Amanda had seen her parents and sisters' death in the disaster at a very young age. She was rescued by priests from the church. Now she also became a revenger for necromancers.
hero.cathedral-town.amanda.name: Amanda
hero.cathedral-town.brooke.biography: Andreas quited his master and did not choose to be a squire any longer. He never suppose that he can become a real knight after finishing his squire experience. Now he started to fight for himself!
hero.cathedral-town.brooke.name: Andreas
hero.cathedral-town.brooke.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offence skill.
hero.cathedral-town.erika.biography: Gonzalez's father used to be a brave knight in Erathia. However, he never would like to live in his father's shadow. Finally he left Erathia since his father's death, but he still reserves the armor which was used by his father. Anyhow he believes he can get the bless from his father's courage.
hero.cathedral-town.erika.name: Gonzalez
hero.cathedral-town.erika.specialty.desc: Increases Speed of any Templars and Dark Templars by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.cathedral-town.erika.specialty.name: Templars
hero.cathedral-town.helena.biography: Serving as a noble girl, Alexia never mentions about her family and old story. She is only known as a fighter. When other noble girls are learning etiquettes at home, she has already standed on the battlefield with armor. Maybe she pursues a better life, with battle and adventure.
hero.cathedral-town.helena.name: Alexia
hero.cathedral-town.helena.specialty.des: Increases kingdom's income by 350 gold per day.
hero.cathedral-town.kasumi.biography: Caballero is a gnoll and used to be a guard who belonged to King Tarossik. After a failure assassination he was banished to a board village. In this place he experienced invasion of undead and suffered from plague and disaster. Now he becomes a member of church and starts a new life.
hero.cathedral-town.kasumi.name: Caballero
hero.cathedral-town.kasumi.specialty.des: Increases Speed of any Slayers and Executioners by 1 and their Attack and defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.cathedral-town.nariko.biography: Leonor suffered this disaster only in her nine-year-old age. She stayed at home for almost 5 days without water until a cleric saved her and put her into the church. She still supposes the man who saved her is actually an angel. Now she becomes increasingly pious even fanatic because of this steadfast faith.
hero.cathedral-town.nariko.name: Leonor
hero.cathedral-town.nariko.specialty.des: Increases Speed of any Couatls and Bloody Couatls by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.cathedral-town.noli.biography: Nathaniel is well-known from his arrogance. He joint the church while he was defeated by necromancers in defending the board of Erathia. Now it is the time for revenge!
hero.cathedral-town.noli.name: Nathaniel
hero.cathedral-town.noli.specialty.descr: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill.
hero.cathedral-town.noli.specialty.name: Armorer
hero.cathedral-town.patricia.biography: Lucero is crazy about hunting harpies and medusas. She likes collecting their bones, skulls or some other 'souvenirs' from the bodies. Hunting is her hobby, even if no one will recruit her to do this.
hero.cathedral-town.patricia.name: Lucero
hero.cathedral-town.patricia.specialty.d: Increases Speed of any Witch Hunters and Evil Hunters by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.cathedral-town.ranin.biography: Von Fredrich was the mayor of the destructed city. He survived from the disaster, but his wife and three children were killed by undead creatures. He still confesses in the chapel everyday although the disaster has already past many years. He believes his sin and must be expiated by himself.
hero.cathedral-town.ranin.name: Von Fredrich
hero.cathedral-town.ranin.specialty.desc: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Resistance skill.
hero.cathedral-town.ranin.specialty.name: Resistance
hero.cathedral-town.salvirana.biography: Farrebique used to be an angel but his wings were burned from this disaster. He cannot fly any more so he pretended himself as a cleric. Although losing the flying ability, he has never supposed he is fallen. Yes, simply because he dreams of light.
hero.cathedral-town.salvirana.name: Farrebique
Increases the Health of allied creatures by +10%.
hero.cathedral-town.stefan.biography: Franco J was the city's bishop and saved many people when disaster struck. But now he believes punishment is more effective than redemption. He believes that the disaster of that year could have been God's punishment for the blasphemers. Therefore, he is determined to protect the rebuilt Church and will no longer show mercy to anyone he deems sinful.
hero.cathedral-town.stefan.name: Franco J
hero.cathedral-town.stefan.specialty.des: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Intelligence skill.
hero.cathedral-town.susan.biography: Camellia's name comes from the blooming flowers in the garden. She grew up in a big manor which belonged to her family, but finally her life was destructed by disaster. Now serving as a survivor, she executes punishment for the church. She supposes beautiful garden will be reappeared after all villains are punished.
hero.cathedral-town.susan.name: Camellia
hero.cathedral-town.susan.specialty.desc: Casts Frost Ring with damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.cathedral-town.susan.specialty.name: Frost Ring
hero.cathedral-town.sveneld.biography: Gabrielle is a daughter of a priest. She suffered the disaster while as a child. Her father was killed by undead creatures thus she said no one hates necromancers more than her. She became a cleric only for bringing the punishment for all necromancers.
hero.cathedral-town.sveneld.name: Gabrielle
hero.cathedral-town.tarinus.biography: Palencia turned fanatic after the disaster, even if she is just a cleric apprentice before. She had seen her classmates are all dead in this disaster, so she decided to fight for herself. Now she became a high priest for the church.
hero.cathedral-town.tarinus.name: Palencia
hero.cathedral-town.tarinus.specialty.de: Increases Speed of any Sextons and Cantors by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.cathedral-town.volh.biography: Jean Cesar's best friend was dead in the disaster. It changed the heart for the man who used to be devoutness. After that, he has become increasingly insane and inaccessible. People said his intention of revenge has already destroys his remained benovolent.
hero.cathedral-town.volh.name: Jean Cesar
hero.cathedral-town.volh.specialty.descr: Casts Fireball with damage increased by 3% for every N hero levels, where N is the level of the target creature.
hero.cathedral-town.volh.specialty.name: Fireball
hero.cathedral-town.vseglas.biography: Someone said Riera looks like the Countess in tale, but she is really a kind woman and often helps the poverty. Maybe such view only because her husband Baron Von Schiffer was dead in the disaster and became a vampire by necromancers.
hero.cathedral-town.vseglas.name: Riera the Baroness
hero.cathedral-town.vseglas.specialty.de: Casts Weakness with effect increased by 3 for level 1–2 creatures, by 2 for level 3–4 creatures, and by 1 for level 5–6 creatures.
